title: Dust & Amber
code:
setcpm(78/4)
arrange(
  [12, stack(
    note("<[eb3,g3,bb3] [ab3,c4,eb4]>/2").s("piano").gain(0.7).room(0.5).decay(0.8).sustain(0.3).lpf(1200),
    s("bd ~ ~ ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.85),
    s("[~ hh]*4").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.45).pan(sine.range(0.3,0.7)).degradeBy(0.2)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<[eb3,g3,bb3] [ab3,c4,eb4] [bb3,d4,f4] [ab3,c4,eb4]>").s("piano").gain(0.75).room(0.55).decay(0.9).sustain(0.35).lpf(sine.slow(8).range(900,2200)),
    s("bd ~ bd ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.9),
    s("[~ hh]*4").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.5).pan(sine.range(0.25,0.75)).degradeBy(0.15),
    s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.65).room(0.4),
    note("<eb2 ab2 bb2 ab2>*2").s("triangle").gain(0.55).lpf(400).decay(0.3).sustain(0.1)
  )],
  [20, stack(
    note("<[eb3,g3,bb3] [ab3,c4,eb4] [bb3,d4,f4] [g3,bb3,eb4]>").s("piano").gain(0.8).room(0.5).decay(1.0).sustain(0.4).lpf(2000).off(0.25, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.35).lpf(1500)),
    s("bd ~ bd ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.95),
    s("[~ hh hh ~]*2").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.55).pan(sine.range(0.2,0.8)).degradeBy(0.1),
    s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.7).room(0.35).crush(8),
    note("<eb2 ab1 bb1 g1>*4").s("triangle").gain(0.6).lpf(500).decay(0.25).sustain(0.05),
    n("<0 2 4 7>*2").scale("Eb3:minor").s("arpy").gain(0.4).room(0.6).pan(0.65).lpf(1800).delay(0.2)
  )],
  [14, stack(
    note("<[eb3,g3,bb3,d4] [ab3,c4,eb4] [bb3,d4,f4] [ab3,c4,eb4]>").s("piano").gain(0.85).room(0.6).decay(1.2).sustain(0.5).lpf(2500).delay(0.15),
    s("bd ~ ~ bd").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.9),
    s("[hh ~ hh hh]*2").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.5).pan(sine.range(0.3,0.7)).degradeBy(0.2),
    s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.65).room(0.5),
    n("<0 4 7 9 4 2 0 7>/2").scale("Eb3:minor").s("arpy").gain(0.45).room(0.55).pan(0.6).lpf(2000).delay(0.25),
    note("<eb2 ab1 bb1 g1>*2").s("sine").gain(0.5).lpf(300).decay(0.4).sustain(0.15)
  )],
  [20, stack(
    note("<[eb3,g3,bb3] [ab3,c4,eb4] [bb3,d4,f4] [g3,bb3,d4]>").s("piano").gain(0.9).room(0.5).decay(1.0).sustain(0.45).lpf(sine.slow(16).range(1200,3000)).off(0.25, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3).lpf(1400)),
    s("bd ~ bd ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(1.0),
    s("[~ hh]*4").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.6).pan(sine.range(0.25,0.75)).degradeBy(0.1),
    s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.75).room(0.3).crush(6),
    s("oh ~ ~ ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.35).room(0.4).pan(0.3),
    note("<eb2 ab1 bb1 eb2>*4").s("triangle").gain(0.65).lpf(600).decay(0.2).sustain(0.05),
    n("<0 2 4 7 9 7 4 2>").scale("Eb3:minor").s("arpy").gain(0.5).room(0.5).pan(0.7).lpf(2200).delay(0.2).every(4, x => x.rev())
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<[eb3,g3,bb3] [c3,eb3,g3] [bb2,d3,f3] [ab2,c3,eb3]>").s("piano").gain(0.8).room(0.7).decay(1.4).sustain(0.5).lpf(1800).delay(0.3),
    s("bd ~ ~ ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.75),
    s("[~ hh]*4").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.4).pan(sine.range(0.3,0.7)).degradeBy(0.3),
    n("<0 4 7 4 2 0>").scale("Eb3:minor").s("arpy").gain(0.4).room(0.7).pan(0.6).lpf(1600).delay(0.35),
    note("<eb2 c2 bb1 ab1>").s("sine").gain(0.45).lpf(250).decay(0.5).sustain(0.2).room(0.4)
  )],
  [12, stack(
    note("<[eb3,g3,bb3] [ab3,c4,eb4]>/2").s("piano").gain(0.6).room(0.8).decay(1.6).sustain(0.4).lpf(800),
    s("bd ~ ~ ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.65),
    s("[~ hh]*4").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.3).pan(sine.range(0.3,0.7)).degradeBy(0.4),
    note("<eb2 ab1>").s("sine").gain(0.4).lpf(200).decay(0.6).sustain(0.25).room(0.6)
  )]
)
